name: @moneyonchain/proposals-changers
description: Money on Chain governance proposals and changers

scripts.test:mocha: hardhat clean && hardhat compile --no-tests contracts/mocks/MoCMock.sol contracts/changers/remove_panic_button/RemovePanicButtonProposal.sol && hardhat test mocha --no-compile
scripts.test:solidity: for test_file in contracts/tests/*.t.sol; do hardhat test solidity "$test_file" || exit 1; done
scripts.deploy:alpha-testnet:coin-pair-price-upg: npx hardhat --network rskAlphaTestnet ignition deploy ignition/modules/CoinPairPriceUpgradeChanger.js --deployment-id coin-pair-price-upgrade-rsk-alpha-testnet
